finite_ce_quotient.construction: Chevalley-Eilenberg cochain complex of the twelve-generator gauge algebra in its adjoint representation
hypotheses: The complex uses the twelve homogeneous gauge generators and the bare structure constants.
The coefficient module is the adjoint representation, not the complete matter/Higgs Fock space.
Cochains are truncated at ghost degree three; degrees 0..2 are reported.
Ranks and harmonic bases are SVD measurements with tolerance 1e-9, not interval enclosures.
not_claimed: No field-theoretic BRST cohomology or gauge-invariant Hilbert space.
No representative map for the complete E1 operator; the bridge keeps that quotient_map null.
No anomaly, infinite-mode, cutoff or continuum statement.

theorem.remaining: Q^2 is measured on the finite complex; the field-theoretic BRST complex, its inner product completion and the physical quotient remain open.
theorem.statement: Q^2 = 0 on the finite adjoint CE complex and H^k = ker Q_k / im Q_{k-1}

artifact.quotient_note: No field-level physical quotient or BRST cohomology is constructed; the finite adjoint Chevalley-Eilenberg quotient is bound separately under finite_ce_quotient, while these are finite-image residual checks only.

hypotheses: The twelve generators use all eight SU(3) colours, the three SU(2) generators and U(1)_Y with bare structure constants.
Ghosts are the twelve modes at GHOST_BASE..GHOST_BASE+12; the joint charge is Q = sum c_a G_a - (i/2) f_abc c_a c_b b_a.
Residuals are f64 finite-image operator norms; they are not interval enclosures or continuum claims.
The Hamiltonian is the complete E1 Cadabra-derived operator, not a projected window.
not_claimed: No physical BRST cohomology or gauge-invariant Hilbert space.
No representative/quotient map; quotient_map is deliberately null.
No anomaly, infinite-mode, cutoff or continuum statement.
No certified interval enclosure of the measured residuals.

operator.name: twelve homogeneous SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1) Gauss generators and joint BRST charge

state.note: finite images only; no field-level representative/quotient map is bound (the finite adjoint CE quotient is separate)

theorem.remaining: The finite identities are measured in the complete E1 operator. The nested finite adjoint CE quotient is constructed separately, but no Lean theorem binds these finite identities. A direct probe shows the joint charge removes one ghost and preserves the remaining occupation, so the total-occupation filtration is Q-invariant and a finite field-level complex is constructible; that full Fock matrix and its cohomology are not yet bound. The field-level quotient/cohomology and anomaly analysis remain open.
theorem.statement: sum_a c_a G_a and the joint Q close on the declared finite images, and Q^2 = 0 there
